improvements.message: Consider adding more advanced scoring logic, such as weighting based on user-defined preferences or historical data trends, to improve the flexibility of the scoring system.
Enhance the filtering module to support multi-select filters for categories and games, as this could improve usability for users managing large datasets.
Add support for IndexedDB or other scalable storage solutions to handle larger datasets, as localStorage may not suffice for extensive use cases.
Improve the rendering logic to include pagination or infinite scrolling for better performance when displaying large datasets.
Expand the smoke test coverage to include edge cases, such as malformed JSON imports, empty datasets, and extreme filter values, to ensure robustness.
Include a troubleshooting section to guide users on resolving common issues, such as browser compatibility or localStorage limits.
Add a section on potential future enhancements, such as integrating with cloud storage or real-time data streams, to provide a roadmap for scalability.

payload.quality_target: The project meets the stated requirements and is well-structured for its intended use case. Improvements focus on scalability, usability, and advanced features for future iterations.
